Definition of SOVD data SOVD data is defined by the DiagnosticSovdContent , which itself, is composed out of one or more DiagnosticSovdContentElement (s). The DM uses the inter- face ara::diag::GenericDiagnosticSovdContent to read or write the entire data, while applying the data conversion rules defined in Chapter 7.3.3.3.2 “SOVD Data – Conversion”. [SWS_DM_01432] SOVD method Read a data resource from an Entity – data query Upstream requirements: RS_Diag_04260 ⌈ If the SOVD method Read a data ressource is received, the DM shall call the corresponding ara::diag::GenericDiagnosticSovdContent::Read method and send a response body according to ASAM SOVD [5][14] and set the following attribute values: id to shortName of DiagnosticSovdContent , data as enumeration of all DiagnosticSovdContentElement s aggregated by the DiagnosticSovdContent with: ValueName set to the shortName of the DiagnosticSovdContentElement Value retrieved by [SWS_DM_02165] ⌋ [SWS_DM_02164] Retrieval of SOVD content Upstream requirements: RS_Diag_04260 ⌈ To read SOVD data, the DM shall use the ara::diag::GenericDiagnos- ticSovdContent::Read method that is mapped via DiagnosticSovdContent- PortMapping . ⌋ [SWS_DM_02165] Retrieval of SOVD content element data Upstream requirements: RS_Diag_04260 ⌈ To retrieve the value of an DiagnosticSovdContentElement , the DM shall eval- uate the DiagnosticSovdContentElementData provided by [SWS_DM_02164] and retrieve the data of the requested DiagnosticSovdContentElement (s) from the returned DiagnosticSovdContentElementData object, by fetching the content via ara::diag::DiagnosticSovdContentElementDataWithKey:: GetContent , while ara::diag::DiagnosticSovdContentElementDataWith- Key::GetName is matching the shortName of the DiagnosticSovdContentEle- ment . ⌋ 205 of 1171 Document ID 723: AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_Diagnostics

Specification of Diagnostics AUTOSAR AP R25-11 [SWS_DM_01431] Support of SOVD method Write a data resource from an Entity Upstream requirements: RS_Diag_04260 ⌈ For each DiagnosticSovdData , the DMshall provide the SOVD method Write a data resource from an Entity according to ASAM SOVD [5][14]. The write method is optional and is based on the presence of DiagnosticSovdData . DiagnosticSovdMethod.put . ⌋ [SWS_DM_02166] SOVD method Write a data resource from an Entity – data query Upstream requirements: RS_Diag_04260 ⌈ If the SOVD method Write a data resource is received, the DM shall call the corresponding GenericDiagnosticSovdContent::Write method with the Diag- nosticSovdContentData data created with: • DiagnosticSovdContentElementDataWithKey::SetName with the shortName of the DiagnosticSovdContentElement • DiagnosticSovdContentElementDataWithKey::SetContent with the value derived from the conversation rules defined in Chapter 7.3.3.3.2 “SOVD Data – Conversion”. ⌋ 7.3.3.5.2 SOVD API – Configuration The ASAM SOVD[5] standard generally supports two different approaches for the API Methods for Configuration : • Configurations as parameter , using MIME type application/json with defined Response Body structure. • Configurations as bulk-data , using bulk like MIME types , such as application/octet-stream . For the realization of these SOVD API Methods for Configuration two different approaches have been realized: • Configurations as parameter derived from DiagnosticSovdContent under us- age of DiagnosticSovdConfigContentMapping . • Configurations as parameter or Configurations as bulk-data re- alized explicitly by modelling and using the dedicated ara::diag::SovdCon- figuration::SovdConfiguration Interface 206 of 1171 Document ID 723: AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_Diagnostics
